saw_lines: Nobody swaps sugary syrup for a diet one on a claim alone. They switch once a flavour they trust tastes right.
So the switch is won or lost in the first line, before a buyer ever reaches the flavour list or the price.
Your site offers percent off, but only 4 of 25 copy ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 20 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers percent off, yet only 4 of 25 copy ads mention it. A new buyer sees no reason to act today. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative itself.
None of your 25 copy ads shows a proof number, so a stranger has nothing to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

2 of 25 ads are creator posts with a code, #ad or @mention, run from the brand page. Buyers trust a creator’s voice, and a brand repost loses that edge. Whitelist these posts from the creator account, then cut three variations.

18 different openings run across 25 copy ads, and the biggest leads only 2. Buyers see no story twice, so none builds recognition. Pick the two best openings and build the next batch from them, with three variations each.
